biggest_catch: The $800 is split: a $500 one-time bonus plus $25 a month for 12 months of debit-card activity — you need 10 qualifying debit purchases every single month for a year to get the full $800, and the offer window closes September 30, 2026.
catches: Checking-side total is $500 one-time plus $25/month for up to 12 months ($300) = $800; the $25/month piece requires qualifying debit-card activity each month for 12 months.
Open a qualifying checking account (excluding Simple Checking for Students) between May 1 and September 30, 2026 — offer window closes 9/30/2026.
Fund the new account and enroll in eStatements within the first 30 days of opening.
You must not currently have, or have had, a CSB personal checking account in the last 12 months.

Use your account as required during the qualification window — the offer page's qualification cards list the specific direct-deposit, average-balance, and debit-card activity thresholds for each bonus piece; confirm the numbers on the official page before applying.
Bonus is automatically credited within 2 months after the qualification period ends.
Limit one per customer; cannot be combined with other offers; can be withdrawn or modified at any time; bonuses reported to the IRS as interest.
Must live or work in the bank's service area (MA/NH per the candidate; confirm current geography on the official page).
